sentiment: Every mind agrees on the shape of us from far away; only walking the near ground tells us anything new.

stories.title: Local Wikipedia: Wikipedia, but only for things a half hour walk from you
stories.summary: An encyclopedia shrunk to the radius of a walk — knowledge measured not by how much it covers, but by how near it stands.

stories.title: Every AI model has the same "controversial" take on humans
stories.summary: Many minds, one answer about us — a reminder that agreement at a distance is not the same as knowing anything close up.

stories.title: The foolishness of "natural language programming" (1978)
stories.summary: An old caution against dressing real work in easy words — precision, not fluency, is what makes a thing stand.
